SELECT latest.vehicle_id, v.vin, latest.id AS latest_invoice_id, latest.invoice_seq AS latest_invoice_seq, latest.invoice_type AS latest_invoice_type, latest.invoice_no AS latest_invoice_no, latest.invoice_date AS latest_invoice_date, CASE WHEN latest.invoice_type = 'INVOICED' THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS has_formal_invoice, cnt.invoice_count FROM t_veh_invoice latest INNER JOIN ( SELECT vehicle_id, MAX(invoice_seq) AS max_seq, COUNT(1) AS invoice_count FROM t_veh_invoice WHERE deleted = 0 GROUP BY vehicle_id ) cnt ON cnt.vehicle_id = latest.vehicle_id AND cnt.max_seq = latest.invoice_seq INNER JOIN t_vehicle v ON v.id = latest.vehicle_id AND v.deleted = 0 WHERE latest.deleted = 0
AND v.vin LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.vin}, '%')
AND latest.invoice_type = #{query.invoiceType}
AND latest.invoice_type = 'INVOICED'
AND latest.invoice_type != 'INVOICED'
ORDER BY latest.id DESC
